What $379,000 Gets You in Tanglewood Community, Temple, Texas!

FREE GUIDE:
Home Buyer Guide → https://bit.ly/3AloH57 

Welcome to Tanglewood in Temple, Texas! Join me as I take you on a tour of a beautiful 4-bed, 2-bath home listed for $379,000 in this serene lakeside community. If you're curious about what $379K can buy in Central Texas, this is the home to check out!

🏡 15902 Salado Drive Temple, TX 76502

• 4 Bedrooms, 2 Baths, 1,800+ sq ft of living space
• Built in 2020 with modern finishes
• Amazing community amenities including a pool, park, and walking trail to the lake
• Gorgeous, open living spaces with tree views from every window
• Luxury wood-style vinyl flooring, stainless steel appliances, and granite countertops

✨ *Bonus:* Deer sightings in your backyard, a peaceful covered patio, and room to add your own touch to the land!

📅 Schedule your tour today and explore the charm and convenience of Temple Texas living!
